title: # All in one suite
description: Mail, Calendar, Contacts and To Do in a single native Windows app. Connect Microsoft Outlook (Office 365), Gmail, any standard IMAP/SMTP server, and remote CalDAV calendars — all from one place.

title: # Wino Intelligence
description: Summaries, smart replies and natural language search. Run it locally on your device or connect your own cloud model — you decide what leaves your machine.

title: # Faster and More Secure
description: A natively compiled core brings quicker start-up, lower memory use and snappier folder switching. Sign and encrypt your mail with S/MIME personal certificates.

title: # Outlook, Gmail & IMAP/SMTP
description: Connect all your email accounts in one place. Wino supports Microsoft Outlook (Office 365), Gmail, and any standard IMAP/SMTP server — giving you a unified inbox experience.

title: # Conversation Threading
description: Follow discussions with ease. Emails are grouped by conversation thread so you never lose context in long email chains.

title: # Rich Customization
description: Make Wino yours. Choose from built-in themes, create custom themes with your own wallpapers and accent colors, configure swipe actions, and set keyboard shortcuts.
